$description: Font families the clone actually loads (Google Fonts, all SIL OFL), weight scale, tracking overrides and the full size/line-height/letter-spacing scale. The original site's commercial display and text faces are NOT licensed for this project and must never be named, loaded or requested as substitutes.

display.note: Display/headline face, loaded at optical size 144 and weight axis 300-700.

sans.note: Text/UI face (weights 400/500/600/700). The config's second alias that also resolves to Inter is folded in here.

accent.note: Weight 600 only; one heading on the press-kit page.

display.note: Display-face weight chosen to match the stroke of the original's (unlicensed) display face; substitute-face value, not a measurement of the original.

display-sub.note: Substitute-face tracking override (not a measured value of the original): applied after the size token so the open-source display face matches measured line widths.
